ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

must_have_properties: Every command on CMD shall be a 48-bit frame: Start(0) + Tx(1) + CMD6 + ARG32 + CRC7 + End(1).
Every R1/R6/R7 response shall be 48 bits; R2 (CID/CSD) shall be 136 bits.
CRC7 polynomial x^7+x^3+1 shall protect CMD frames and most card responses.
CRC16 polynomial x^16+x^12+x^5+1 (CCITT) shall protect each DAT block per active DAT line.
Card shall implement the 10-state state machine (Inactive, Idle, Ready, Ident, Stby, Tran, Data, Rcv, Prg, Dis).
Card shall complete ACMD41 initialization within 1 second.
Card shall hold DAT0 LOW while programming a write block; release HIGH on completion.
Host shall apply ≥ 74 dummy CLK cycles after VDD stable + 1 ms before issuing CMD0.
Host shall use open-drain on CMD during identification (CMD0..CMD3); push-pull thereafter.
Default block length shall be 512 B; SDSC accepts CMD16 to change it; SDHC/SDXC ignore CMD16 for read.
Argument to CMD17/CMD24/CMD25 shall be byte address for SDSC and block address (×512) for SDHC/SDXC.
ACMD* commands shall be preceded by CMD55 in the same active state.
Voltage switch (CMD11) shall only be initiated after ACMD41 with S18A=1.
After CMD11, host shall stop CLK ≥ 5 ms during VDDIO transition.
UHS-I SDR104 shall require host tuning via CMD19 (SEND_TUNING_BLOCK).
SPI mode shall be entered by holding CS LOW during CMD0; card stays in SPI mode until power cycle.
must_not_have_properties: Host shall not issue a dependent command while DAT0 is LOW (busy); CMD13 is the only allowed command.
Host shall not retry CMD8 after a v1.x card returns no response — that response is the signal that the card is v1.x.
Card shall not respond if CMD CRC7 is invalid.
Once PERM_WRITE_PROTECT is set via CMD27, the bit can never be cleared.
Card shall not allow voltage switch back from 1.8 V to 3.3 V without a full power cycle.
Multiple cards on the same bus shall not transmit on CMD simultaneously after CMD3 (each has unique RCA).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Bad CRC7 from host — card ignores command; host detects no response.
Bad CRC16 from host — card returns Data Response Token 101.
Host detects bad CRC16 locally; may retry CMD17.
Card sets CSR.ILLEGAL_COMMAND in next R1.
Card sets CSR.CARD_IS_LOCKED; only CMD42/CMD13 allowed.
Card fails to drive CMD/DAT LOW after CMD11 OR fails to release HIGH within 1 ms; host shall power-cycle.
No contiguous pass window for SDR104; host shall drop to SDR50 / DDR50.

fields.min_clock_constraint: Host may stop CLK between transactions (except in UHS-II); minimum CLK frequency = 0 in identification mode (must use 100-400 kHz for ACMD41 / SPI init).
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: CMD0 sets the card to Idle state, RCA = 0x0000, CMD line back to open-drain, OCR voltage window cleared. Power cycle = full reset including any volatile programmed state.
